itens.titulo: Nvidia stock hits new all-time high, market cap at $5.7 trillion
itens.descricao: Nvidia stock hits new all-time high, market cap at $5.7 trillion Yahoo Finance Singapore
trechos: Nvidia (NVDA) stock hit a new all-time intraday high on Friday, eclipsing its prior high of $235.54 a share.
The stock reached $237.55 in early trading, after opening at $236.05.
The company's intraday market cap hit $5.7 trillion.

In its August Q2 earnings report, Nvidia topped Wall Street's already lofty expectations on both the top and bottom lines, reporting revenue of $96.2 billion, and offering a better-than-anticipated outlook for its third quarter.
The company said it expects sales of between $105.8 billion and $110.1 billion.
2022, with investors regularly questioning whether the market is in an AI bubble and, if so, when it will burst.

itens.titulo: Tech stocks jump after jobs report miss, Treasury yields ease: AlphaCheck
itens.descricao: Tech stocks jump after jobs report miss, Treasury yields ease: AlphaCheck Yahoo Finance
trechos: Stocks jumped on Friday after the September jobs report missed expectations, with unemployment inching up to 4.2%.
The 10-year Treasury (^TNX) yield, used as a benchmark for mortgages and other loans, eased to 5.18% after reaching a 2002 peak in the prior session.
Bitcoin (BTC-USD) rose more than 2% to above $86,000 while ether (ETH-USD) also jumped.

itens.titulo: EXCLUSIVE: Micron’s NAND Revenue Surged 526%: Why AI Data Centers Need So Much Storage
itens.descricao: EXCLUSIVE: Micron’s NAND Revenue Surged 526%: Why AI Data Centers Need So Much Storage Yahoo Finance
trechos: Micron Technology Inc. (NASDAQ:MU) saw NAND revenue surge 526% year over year to a record $14.1 billion in its fiscal fourth quarter as AI data centers demanded more storage alongside the high-speed memory used by GPUs.
"If it cannot all fit into HBM, it needs to be spilled over to DRAM, and from there, down to NAND," Hwang said.
Micron's data-center SSD revenue approached $10 billion last quarter, more than 10 times the year-earlier level and more than two-thirds of its total NAND revenue.
Micron's NAND prices rose about 30% sequentially last quarter.

Even if customers put less memory in each system, "the total volume of required chips increases even faster," Hwang said, calling the cutbacks "a completely different story from an actual drop in purchase volumes."

itens.titulo: Bitcoin rises for third straight week on strong ETF demand
itens.descricao: Bitcoin rises for third straight week on strong ETF demand Yahoo Finance
trechos: Bitcoin climbed above $86,000 on Friday, posting a third consecutive weekly gain as institutional flows into exchange-traded funds continued to lift demand, according to Bloomberg.
It reached a session high of $86,851, a gain of as much as 2.7%, before settling near $86,400.
The move extended a roughly 2% gain for the week and capped a 40% advance for the three months through September — the cryptocurrency's strongest quarter since late 2024.
Bitcoin had lost more than half its value from an all-time high above $126,000 reached last October, according to Bloomberg.
"Investors globally have observed this relative strength," Pratik Kala, head of research at Apollo Crypto, told Bloomberg.
Last year bucked that trend, with a 7% decline that stung all the more given it followed Bitcoin's record-setting peak.

The backdrop also sets a buoyant tone for Token2049, the industry conference scheduled for Singapore next week, where the atmosphere among executives is considerably brighter than anyone would have predicted earlier in the summer, according to the outlet.
